verdict.rationale: Viam documents official SDKs in Python, Go, C++, TypeScript and Flutter. Its machine API and fleet management API are usable from code, and the SDKs handle WebRTC/gRPC transport, sessions and automatic reconnection. The docs explicitly say an AI agent with an SDK can operate a machine, and a community commenter confirms that robot code is written against the Viam SDK. Missing for 10: SDK-specific reference or installation and versioning documentation in the evidence, and hands-on independent corroboration of SDK quality beyond a single HN comment.
